purpose: Exact integer SIMD acceleration of the stable FP32 FFTW blind dwell on x86 servers
changes: natural dual-RX lag-4 rank fold: runtime-dispatched SSSE3/SSE4.1
packed selected-window power/differential fold: runtime-dispatched SSSE3/SSE4.1
packed selected-window nuisance energy/lag sums: runtime-dispatched SSSE3/SSE4.1

integer_semantics.product: each signed int16 multiply produces one signed int32 product
integer_semantics.complex_add: each individual int32 product is sign-extended to int64 before rr+ii or ri-ir
integer_semantics.accumulation: int64, no overflow for declared dwell bounds
integer_semantics.downstream: unchanged FP32 FFTW, FP64 reductions, starts, support, tie rules, nuisance, and GLRT

dispatch.force_scope: thread-local; mode cannot race with other caller threads

component_gate.required_scientific_equality: exact rank/order/epochs/candidates and all non-timing result fields
component_gate.timing: P-core 0 when permitted, one warmup and at least 9 counterbalanced scalar/SIMD repetitions

dataset_run_if_component_gate_passes.timing: complete caller thread CPU and wall latency; no multiplied ratios

stop_rules: Stop before dataset replay if exact component equality or either per-rate 1.10x complete-call gate fails.
Reject promotion on any scientific identity/control change.
No threshold/statistic tuning, holdout, RF, production, or ARM claim.
